_comment: Tolerated security advisories. Every entry needs an owner and an expiry, and CI runs
`python -m scripts.audit --strict`, which fails once the date passes — a tolerated
advisory is a scheduled decision, not a permanent silence (plan M2.4).
Empty on purpose: the last run (opentelemetry-api 1.45.1, setuptools 84.0.0) was fixed
by upgrading the lock file instead of tolerating it.
